what: SPX close candle scan, step 2 (HOLDOUT 2021-01-01 .. 2026-10-20), run on the frozen candidate list after its SHA-256 matched.
summary_plain_english: 3 candle feature(s) were picked using 2013-2020 only, frozen, and tested on 2021-2026: 2 passed (one-sided test, Holm 5%).

F2_1m_1550_strong_body (+1 = trade in the signal direction): 2021-2026 right 57.5% of 644 trades (95% CI 53.6%-61.2%), mean 1.05 bps/day, Holm p 6.28e-05 -> PASSES. Break-even to buy the ATM 0DTE option: 49.5% (size-neutral 51.8%), so the CI lower bound clears it. Descriptive only: 2023-2026 raw-direction hit 54.7% (CI 49.9%-59.3%); same candle at 11:51 hit 50.7%, t 0.61. To confirm going forward at 80% power: about 244 trades for the hit rate to beat break-even (~2.2 years at 112 trades/yr), 808 trades for the option P&L itself (~7.2 years). It is the already-known P3 effect in another form (same sign as P3 on 98% of its 2013-2020 signal days), so it is not a new discovery.

F1_1m_15:50 (+1 = trade in the signal direction): 2021-2026 right 54.0% of 1444 trades (95% CI 51.4%-56.6%), mean 0.92 bps/day, Holm p 0.0109 -> PASSES. Break-even to buy the ATM 0DTE option: 51.5% (size-neutral 51.9%), so it is NOT accurate enough to pay for the option. Descriptive only: 2023-2026 raw-direction hit 53.2% (CI 50.0%-56.4%); same candle at 11:51 hit 48.6%, t -1.09. To confirm going forward at 80% power: about 2525 trades for the hit rate to beat break-even (~10.0 years at 252 trades/yr), 7774 trades for the option P&L itself (~30.9 years). It is the already-known P3 effect in another form (same sign as P3 on 93% of its 2013-2020 signal days), so it is not a new discovery.

F4_day_so_far (+1 = trade in the signal direction): 2021-2026 right 48.4% of 1446 trades (95% CI 45.8%-51.0%), mean -0.03 bps/day, Holm p 0.526 -> fails. Break-even to buy the ATM 0DTE option: 51.0% (size-neutral 51.6%), so it is NOT accurate enough to pay for the option.

Cost check: on 22 Robinhood days the ATM straddle cost 1.02x the realized official move on the same days (95% CI 0.68-1.65), consistent with the 'fair straddle' cost assumption but too few days to pin it down.

Plain answer: only the 15:50 one-minute candle works, and it is the effect already known as P3. Its strong-body version cleared the pre-registered accuracy bar on 2021-2026 under the fair-straddle cost assumption, on the Dukascopy CFD series to the 15:59 bar (not the official settlement). It is a lead to confirm with forward trades, not a proven edge. Of the other features, 38 never reached the discovery bar and 2 candidate(s) did not clear the accuracy bar.

decisions_and_interpretations.text: Each feature is assigned the earliest pre-registered entry its candles allow: a feature whose candles all close by 15:48:59 uses entry 15:49 (target r(15:49 open -> 15:59 close)); a feature that uses the 15:49 or 15:50 one-minute bar uses entry 15:51 (target r(15:51 open -> 15:59 close)). So F1 15:30..15:48 and F3 15:20..15:40 enter at 15:49; F1 15:49, F1 15:50, every F2 shape (the 15:50 1-minute candle and the 15:45-15:49 five-minute candle, which closes at 15:49:59) and F3 15:45 enter at 15:51; every F4 feature is a 'day level at entry' and enters at 15:49.
decisions_and_interpretations.kind: implementation choice (the pre-registration's entry rule applied feature by feature)

decisions_and_interpretations.text: F4: P = open of the entry bar (15:49). CLV = (P - day low)/(day high - day low) with high/low over the 1-minute bars 09:30..15:48 and P itself; signal sign(CLV - 0.5), 0 if high = low. Opening gap = sign(09:30 open - prior session's 15:59 close). Prior-day candle = sign(prior session's 15:59 close - its 09:30 open). The prior session is the previous NYSE session in d1_days.csv (calendar != nyse_holiday); if that session is not in the keep set (no bars) the two prior-day features are undefined for that day (dropped, not zero). Day-so-far = P1 = sign(ln(15:49 open / 09:30 open)).

F2 candle = (open of its first minute, max high, min low, close of its last minute); body = close - open, range = high - low, upper wick = high - max(open, close), lower wick = min(open, close) - low. strong body: sign(body) if range > 0 and |body| >= 0.6 range, else 0. hammer: +1 if range > 0, lower wick >= 2|body| and lower wick >= 0.6 range, else 0. shooting star: -1 if range > 0, upper wick >= 2|body| and upper wick >= 0.6 range, else 0. engulfing vs the prior candle of the same size (1-minute 15:49; five-minute 15:40-15:44): +1 if prior close < prior open, current close > current open, current open <= prior close and current close >= prior open; -1 for the mirror case; else 0. big candle: sign(body) if |body| >= 2 x the median (high - low) of the day's 1-minute bars from 09:30 through the candle's last minute, else 0. A candle with any of its bars missing is undefined (dropped).

The P3 reference row is P3 exactly as in spx_close_1549/analysis.py: sign(ln(15:51 open / 15:50 open)), entry 15:51. It is never eligible as a candidate and is outside the BH family. F1 15:50 (sign(close - open) of the 15:50 bar) and the F2 shapes on the 15:50 candle are in the 41 as the pre-registration lists them; any candidate whose non-zero signals agree with P3 on >= 90% of discovery days is flagged overlaps_known_P3, because P3's 2013-2026 result (which includes the holdout years) was known when the pre-registration was written, so its holdout is not a clean out-of-sample test.

Per feature: y = signal x target x 1e4 over days where both are defined; mean and Newey-West t (lag 5) over all those days (zero-signal days contribute 0, as in analysis.py); hit rate = share of days with signal != 0 and target != 0 on which signal x target > 0. Discovery p-values are two-sided normal; BH q-values over the 41. Holdout: one-sided normal p of mean > 0 with the frozen direction; Holm over the candidates. Hit-rate 95% CI = Wilson score interval treating days as independent.
decisions_and_interpretations.kind: implementation choice (statistics as in analysis.py where it has them)

decisions_and_interpretations.text: Buy one ATM 0DTE call (signal x direction > 0) or put (< 0) at the entry price, strike = entry price (idealised ATM), hold to the 15:59 close. Payoff = |move| on correct days, 0 on wrong days (a zero move counts as wrong). Option cost = half the realized-move-fair straddle = 0.5 x mean |move| over the candidate's holdout trade days, + $0.10 half-spread + one fee ($0.09 or $0.74 per contract = 0.0009 or 0.0074 points; no exit fee at expiry, as analysis.py). Break-even hit rate = cost / mean |move| on correct days (primary, uses the correct- vs wrong-day |move| distribution); also reported: the size-neutral break-even cost / mean |move| (= 0.5 + (spread + fee)/mean|move|) and both at the last D1 price level (moves in return units x the 2026-10-20 15:49 open). Trades needed (one-sided 5%, 80% power, iid normal approximation): n = ((z_a + z_b) sd / mean)^2 for the per-trade signed return and for the per-trade option P&L; for the hit rate vs 50% and vs the break-even, n = ((z_a sqrt(p0 q0) + z_b sqrt(p q)) / (p - p0))^2.
decisions_and_interpretations.kind: implementation choice (the pre-registration's step 4 made concrete)

decisions_and_interpretations.text: Cross-check: on the 22 Robinhood 10-minute days the ATM straddle = call + put 15:40-bar close (last trade in 15:40:00-15:49:59, about 15:50) at the strike nearest the SPX 15:49-bar close, in bps of that SPX price, versus the assumed realized-move-fair straddle (D1 holdout mean |move| in bps, for the 15:49 and 15:51 entries, which bracket a 15:50 mark) and versus the official |settle - S| on the same days. The two fully priced days use the 15:49 one-minute marks: 2026-10-20 from spx_close_1549/results.json, 2026-10-21 from the live scorecard (settlement provisional there).

Placebo: every candidate rebuilt 240 minutes earlier (every bar index - 240: entry 15:49 -> 11:49, 15:51 -> 11:51, target to the 11:59 close; F1 15:40 -> 11:40, etc.), with its frozen direction. Opening gap and prior-day candle keep their signal (only the target moves); day-so-far becomes sign(11:49 open / 09:30 open). Reported on discovery and holdout, descriptive.

The holdout step was re-run on the same frozen file (hash unchanged) after its first run, to change two reporting items: (a) the straddle-cost sensitivity had scaled the option cost by market straddle / D1 holdout mean |move|, a ratio across different volatility regimes (2026 vs 2021-2026) that made the break-even look far too low (about 36%); it now uses the market's markup over the realized official move on the same 22 days, with a bootstrap CI; (b) the plain summary now states the P3 overlap, the 2023-2026 descriptive hit rate, the size-neutral break-even and the calendar time to confirm. No test statistic, candidate, direction, or pre-registered economics number changed (the code is deterministic).

robinhood_10m_days.how_to_read: ratio_market_to_realized_same_days is the market's markup over the realized official move on the same days (1 = priced at realized-move-fair, the pre-registered assumption). The ratio_market_to_assumed_fair_* values compare these 2026 days with the D1 holdout average, i.e. different volatility regimes: below 1 they say the recent move is smaller than the 2021-2026 average, not that options are cheap.
robinhood_10m_days.note: 10-minute closes are last trades in 15:40:00-15:49:59 (about 15:50), not simultaneous with each other or with SPX; the straddle (call + put) is much less sensitive to that than either leg
